notes: Seed homepage redirects to www.banderacounty.gov. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The elections pages link 'Election Results' to the SOS results site (goelect.txelections.civixapps.com/ivis-enr-ui/races) and post the county's own Hart-style PDFs. The server sends no Last-Modified header for these files (page/open/... handler), so there are no upload times; only printed run times. 2026 runoff: 'Precinct Results-5-26-2026' is an Unofficial precinct report run 9:45 PM on election night with Election Day columns and 10 of 10 precincts reporting; treated as END on printed run time only (upload time unknown), confidence low. 2026 primary: only 'Official Canvass/Cumulative/Precinct Results March 3rd Primary'. 2024 general: precinct and cumulative files are 'Official Results' run 04/04/2025. Check 3 pending for 2024 general and 2026 primary (wayback-data branch not found on origin).
tag_rationale: Only the 2026 runoff is determined (END: unofficial precinct report printed 9:45 PM election night, final 10 of 10), so by rule the tag is PRECINCT_END_OF_NIGHT with confidence low.

2024_general.fact: Past Election Results lists 'November 5, 2024 General Election Precinct Results' = 'Precinct Results Report Official Results BANDERA COUNTY, TEXAS 11/5/24 Election Night GENERAL ELECTION ... Run Time 10:26 AM Run Date 04/04/2025', plus canvass and cumulative (also Official, created 2025-04-04); no election-night file. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: Current Elections lists only 'Official Canvass Results', 'Official Cumulative Results' and 'Official Precinct Results March 3rd Primary'; no election-night file. Check 3 pending.
